description: This file manages the lifecycle events of a UI component, including connection, disconnection, and updates, by coordinating polling, theme, and navigation behaviors.

methods.name: handleConnected
methods.description: Initializes connection, applies settings, starts polling, and sets up event listeners when the host connects.

methods.name: handleFirstUpdated
methods.description: Observes the topbar after the component's first update.

methods.name: handleDisconnected
methods.description: Cleans up event listeners, stops polling, and resets state when the host disconnects.

methods.name: handleUpdated
methods.description: Handles state changes, updating scroll positions for chat and logs tabs based on property changes.
